name: instadocs-vscode
description: Generate a Solution Design Document + Test Case Document from an RPA/automation project.

commands.title: Generate SDD + Test Cases (AI · UiPath LLM Gateway)
Generate SDD + Test Cases from Git URL

instadocs.gateway.baseHost.description: UiPath Cloud base host, e.g. https://cloud.uipath.com or https://staging.uipath.com. Leave empty to use your signed-in `uip` session. Combined with organization + tenant to build the Gateway URL.

instadocs.gateway.organization.description: UiPath organization LOGICAL NAME (e.g. acme), not the GUID. Leave empty to use your `uip` session.

instadocs.gateway.tenant.description: UiPath tenant name (case-sensitive, e.g. DefaultTenant). Leave empty to use your `uip` session.

instadocs.gateway.servicePrefix.description: Gateway service prefix. Leave empty to auto-select (agenthub_ for *.uipath.com, else orchestrator_).

instadocs.gateway.baseUrl.description: Full LLM Gateway chat/completions URL. Overrides baseHost/organization/tenant. Leave empty to auto-derive.

instadocs.gateway.model.description: Model id for the LLM Gateway normalized API (e.g. anthropic.claude-opus-4-8, anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929-v1:0, anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0).
